title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: An object expression keeps its members
summary: A property and the object it holds are declared on one line, and the object was cut to that single line. Its overrides left it in the Outline, folding it folded nothing, and an empty duplicate sat next to the property.

highlights.title: One node, with what is inside it
highlights.description: val observer = object : DefaultLifecycleObserver { now shows the property with onStart and onStop under it, instead of an empty object next to it.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: A symbol declared on the same line as another cannot close that one's body. The object expression stopped where the property that names it begins, which is the same line, so it was one line tall. 111 of them on a real Android project.

The Outline lists the name you wrote rather than both. The property and the object describe one construct and had the same extent, so one of the two was always empty. An object passed straight to a call still shows as object : Listener.
